Initial release of product-price-research skill.

- Search and compare products, prices, sellers, and reviews across Amazon, eBay, Shopify, Shop.app, Target, Costco, Zalando, and Walmart using the Crawlora API.
- Returns normalized JSON data; no HTML scraping required.
- Supports product discovery, details lookup, seller review, and price tracking.
- Setup uses a single API key; clear instructions provided.
- Full endpoint reference and example queries included.
